title: The Last Toast at Ravenscroft Manor
note: PLACEHOLDER story for testing the app. The real mystery replaces this in P07.
setting: A stormy evening at Ravenscroft Manor. Lady Ravenscroft has invited old friends to celebrate her 60th birthday. Halfway through her toast, she collapses.

characters.name: Mr. Edmund Pike
characters.biography: You have served the Ravenscroft family for thirty years. You know every corridor of the manor, and every secret whispered in it.

relationships.text: You watched her grow up. Lately she has been asking odd questions about the wine cellar.
He visits Lady Ravenscroft weekly. You don't trust his smile.

secrets: TEST SECRET for PIKE: You have been quietly selling old bottles from the wine cellar for years.
objectives: Keep anyone from looking closely at the wine cellar records.
Find out who moved the birthday champagne.

characters.name: Rosalind Ravenscroft
characters.biography: You are Lady Ravenscroft's only niece and, you have always assumed, her heir. You run a struggling art gallery in the city.

relationships.text: Pike has known you since childhood. He is kind, but he notices everything.
A painter your aunt has taken a sudden liking to. You find this suspicious.

secrets: TEST SECRET for ROSALIND: Your gallery is bankrupt and you owe money to dangerous people.
objectives: Find out whether your aunt changed her will.
Hide your money troubles from everyone.

characters.name: Dr. Silas Thorne
characters.biography: You have been Lady Ravenscroft's doctor for a decade. You are charming, careful, and always carry your medical bag.

relationships.text: The butler watches you too closely. You suspect he dislikes you.
Rosalind once asked you, oddly, how long her aunt might live.

secrets: TEST SECRET for THORNE: You lost your medical licence in another country under a different name.
objectives: Find out who opened your medical bag during dinner.

characters.name: Juniper Vale
characters.biography: You are a young painter whom Lady Ravenscroft recently 'discovered'. She commissioned her birthday portrait from you.

relationships.text: Rosalind runs a gallery and has been cold to you all evening.
The doctor looked startled when he first saw you, as if he recognised you.

secrets: TEST SECRET for JUNIPER: You are Lady Ravenscroft's secret granddaughter, and she told you so last week.
objectives: Decide whether to reveal who you really are.
Learn why the doctor seemed to recognise you.

solution.motive: Lady Ravenscroft discovered Dr. Thorne's false identity and planned to expose him after the party.
solution.method: He added poison from his medical bag to her champagne glass while everyone gathered for the toast.

casting_note: casting.load is 'major' or 'low-pressure'. casting.needs: the minimum answer (1-4) a guest should give on that question. casting.content: sensitive content ('killer', 'romance') that guests can refuse.
